name: Kaburagi Souichirou
source:
The headmaster of Kaikyuu Academy.

He's at the top of the worldwide enterprise, the Kaburagi Group. Wishing to fulfill his teaching ideals, he founded this academy. Though his work keeps him very busy, he always kindly watches over new student Neri, as well as everyone else. He was an acquaintance of Neri's disappeared father, and also invited her to attend Kaikyuu Academy.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
